name: SCOMNET
recent: 公司近期持续进行股份回购，并有多名董事及主要股东在闭门期内外申报持股变动。最新季度（2026年6月30日）营收同比下滑但净利同比上升。
notable: 公司于2026年10月至11月期间多次进行股份回购。
多名董事及主要股东（包括Hsueh Chih-Yu、Wu Huei-Chung、Shiue Jong-Zone等）申报持股变动，部分为在闭门期内增持。
risks: 董事及主要股东在闭门期内进行交易，需留意合规性。
营收同比下滑10.4%，尽管净利同比增长。
earnings: 2026年6月30日季度营收为3388.7万令吉，环比增长14.6%，同比下滑10.4%；净利为710.5万令吉，环比增长25.4%，同比增长12.6%；净利率为21.0%，高于上一季度的19.1%。

recent_en: The company has been continuously buying back shares, with several directors and substantial shareholders reporting changes in their holdings during and outside the closed period. In the latest quarter (30 June 2026), revenue declined year-on-year while net profit rose year-on-year.
notable_en: Several directors and substantial shareholders (including Hsueh Chih-Yu, Wu Huei-Chung, Shiue Jong-Zone, etc.) reported changes in their holdings, with some acquiring shares during the closed period.
risks_en: Directors and substantial shareholders traded during the closed period, warranting attention to compliance.
Revenue declined 10.4% year-on-year, although net profit increased year-on-year.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 33.887 million, up 14.6% QoQ but down 10.4% YoY; net profit was MYR 7.105 million, up 25.4% QoQ and 12.6% YoY; net margin was 21.0%, higher than 19.1% in the previous quarter.
